task.title: Query real consented-traffic and 3D aggregates
task.input: analytics-aggregate, model-events and the role/source matrix
task.output: The stats-core API and source DTOs; GET /api/admin/stats
task.accept: 1) Caller dashboard request leads to stats route and ops service reading actual aggregates; after consent, a visit, GLB activity and a five-minute job, verify today's anonymous browsers/PV/products/3D individually; successful zero results, null with no samples, denominators/terminal states/mean-duration samples must be correct (E-49, E-50, E-61, E-63). 2) ADMIN has all sources, SALES business sources and EDITOR public traffic/3D; unauthorized sources must be rejected or filtered before querying and must not include hidden counts; time-zone changes/expired coverage must have explicit revision/dataThrough rather than stitched trends (E-55, E-58, E-66).
